en.headline: Woman struck by falling banana while exercising in Kwun Tong estate
en.dek: A woman exercising on a fitness bicycle at Po Pui Court was hit on the head by a banana that fell from above at 7:55 a.m., remaining conscious as she was taken to hospital.
body: A woman was struck on the head by a falling banana while exercising at a recreational ground in Po Pui Court, Kwun Tong, on Sunday morning.

Police said the incident occurred at about 7:55 a.m. opposite Po Ying House. The woman was using a fitness bicycle when the banana fell from height and hit her. She felt dizzy but remained conscious and was taken by ambulance to hospital for treatment.
Officers cordoned off the area for investigation. Police are treating the case as one of dropping objects from a height and have handed it to the criminal investigation team.

zh.headline: 觀塘寶珮苑晨運婦被高空墮下香蕉砸中頭部送院
zh.dek: 周日早上約7時55分，一名婦人在寶珮苑寶瑛閣對開休憩處踏健身單車時，遭從高處墮下的香蕉砸中頭部，清醒由救護車送院。
body: 觀塘寶珮苑發生高空墮物傷人事件。周日早上約7時55分，一名婦人在寶瑛閣對開休憩處晨運，正使用健身單車時，突然有香蕉從高處墮下，砸中她的頭部。
女事主感到頭暈不適，但仍保持清醒，其後由救護車送院治理。警方到場封鎖現場調查。
警方相信事件涉及高空擲物，已交由刑事調查隊跟進。
